message:
Hey there - 

I'm in Lakewood (90713) and looking for quotes on some electrical work. 

I'm looking to drop a subpanel (100amp) in my detached garage. Run a 60-80 ft feed run through soil and small bit of hardscaping in the backyard. Then add probably 4-6 15/20 amp branch circuits, 10-12 receptacles/switches/outlets, and 6-8 lighting fixtures, small mini-split, 1 or 2 220/240 connections for welder/future ev/etc. 

Is this type of job something you usually take on? I'm looking to get quotes, submit permits, etc. and ready to move forward with this project when I find the right electrician partner.
